scope: BIOS country-header, directory, object and complete data preflight before DOS table writes; repeated object validation at copy time. QEMU HIGH/LOW ET/LV/LT invalid-resource boot fallback matches the clean default country/API table snapshot, followed by valid-resource recovery. BIOS and NLSFUNC accept both shipped kind-4 UCASE/FUCASE signatures. Current private core and explicit regression scopes are recorded. Later media-error rollback, real-BIOS resource failures, installed text/file workflows and full source-matched release/reproducibility remain open.

CTTY AUX
HIGH.COM
IF ERRORLEVEL 1 GOTO FAIL
SNAP.COM

QEXIT.COM
:FAIL

QEXIT.COM
